note: Both sets treat the legend key symbols "3" and "11" as if they were component values, and both misbind the feeder label "TO PLANTER EQUIPMENT (SEE E-206)" and the WEATHERHEAD to individual modules (SA2-19, SA2-25) when the drawing shows them as items fed from the array output. Set B adds five module-to-module connection claims (SA3-2→SA3-3, SA2-24→SA2-25, SA2-25→SA2-26, SA2-26→SA2-27, SA3-15→SA3-16) whose quotes are not on the page and whose stated "positive to positive" polarity is not supported by the drawing, plus two garbled claims that merge Note 1 (cable type) with Note 2 (cable ties UV rated), and a duplicate junction-box claim. Set A therefore contains the same core correct facts (NEMA 3R junction box on side of house, module +/- terminals) with far fewer unsupported or misbound claims, so A is better despite being shorter.
remarks: The "3" and "11" strings in the text layer are legend key symbols (3 = Sunpreme GX290 solar module, 11 = #10G bonding jumper), not values; both extractors repeatedly bind them as values/identifiers. Both sets omit the important Note 1 (all current-carrying cable is USE-2, 10 G.A) and the legend items (Sunpreme GX290 frameless glass module per E-502, #10G bonding jumper). The text layer is heavily garbled (ENMA for NEMA, 'CA BLE'), and the module string wiring is only readable at high zoom, so the inter-module connection claims could not be verified as drawn.
